description: Mr. Zhang compares sectional, recliner, loveseat, and modular sofa styles before choosing a direction.
visual_style: See style-guide.md for full consistency rules

scenes.description: Li Wei asks what kind of sofa style Mr. Zhang prefers.

lines.speaker: Li Wei
lines.en: Today we can compare several sofa styles side by side.
lines.zh: 今天我们可以把几种沙发款式放在一起比较。

lines.speaker: Mr. Zhang
lines.en: Great. I want something modern, but still comfortable for family use.
lines.zh: 很好。我想要现代一点，但家人使用也要舒服。

lines.speaker: Li Wei
lines.en: Then we should look at a sectional sofa, a recliner sofa, and a loveseat.
lines.zh: 那我们应该看看组合沙发、功能沙发和双人沙发。

scenes.description: Li Wei presents a large sectional sofa for a family living room.

lines.speaker: Li Wei
lines.en: This L-shaped sectional gives you more seats and a relaxed corner.
lines.zh: 这款L形组合沙发座位更多，还有一个放松的转角位。

lines.speaker: Mr. Zhang
lines.en: It looks spacious. Would it make my living room feel crowded?
lines.zh: 看起来很宽敞。会不会让我的客厅显得拥挤？

lines.speaker: Li Wei
lines.en: If your wall is over three meters wide, this layout should work well.
lines.zh: 如果您的墙面超过三米宽，这个布局应该很合适。

scenes.description: They test a sofa with reclining seats and footrests.

lines.speaker: Mr. Zhang
lines.en: What is special about this recliner sofa?
lines.zh: 这款功能沙发有什么特别的地方？

lines.speaker: Li Wei
lines.en: The backrest can lean back, and the footrest comes up smoothly.
lines.zh: 靠背可以向后倾，脚托也能顺滑升起。

lines.speaker: Mr. Zhang
lines.en: This is comfortable for watching movies, but it may need more space.
lines.zh: 看电影会很舒服，但可能需要更多空间。

lines.speaker: Li Wei
lines.en: Yes, please leave at least twenty centimeters behind it.
lines.zh: 是的，请在后面至少留二十厘米空间。

scenes.description: Li Wei shows a compact loveseat for small apartments.

lines.speaker: Li Wei
lines.en: This loveseat is smaller and easier to move into an apartment.
lines.zh: 这款双人沙发更小，更容易搬进公寓。

lines.speaker: Mr. Zhang
lines.en: It is practical, but I may need extra seats for guests.
lines.zh: 它很实用，但我可能需要给客人多准备座位。

lines.speaker: Li Wei
lines.en: You can pair it with two armchairs to keep the room flexible.
lines.zh: 您可以搭配两把单人椅，让房间更灵活。

scenes.description: They discuss a modular sofa that can be rearranged.

lines.speaker: Mr. Zhang
lines.en: Can this modular sofa be rearranged later?
lines.zh: 这款模块化沙发以后可以重新组合吗？

lines.speaker: Li Wei
lines.en: Yes. Each module can be moved, so you can change the layout.
lines.zh: 可以。每个模块都能移动，所以您可以改变布局。

lines.speaker: Mr. Zhang
lines.en: That is useful if I move to a bigger home later.
lines.zh: 如果以后搬到更大的房子，这会很有用。

scenes.description: Mr. Zhang narrows the choice to two sofa styles.

lines.speaker: Li Wei
lines.en: Which style feels closest to what you need?
lines.zh: 哪种款式最接近您的需求？

lines.speaker: Mr. Zhang
lines.en: I prefer the sectional sofa, but I also like the modular design.
lines.zh: 我更喜欢组合沙发，但也喜欢模块化设计。

lines.speaker: Li Wei
lines.en: Good. Next we can compare the materials and colors for those two options.
lines.zh: 好的。接下来我们可以比较这两个选择的材质和颜色。
